business_problem: Cerebriu needed scalable and affordable GPU infrastructure so it could train data-intensive radiology AI models faster and support the company's global expansion plans without overspending on cloud compute.
solution_summary: Cerebriu moved AI model training for its radiology software onto Oracle Cloud Infrastructure using bare metal compute instances with NVIDIA GPUs. The OCI environment gives the startup higher GPU availability, more GPU memory for the same price, and easier instance launch than its alternatives, allowing the team to run parallel image-processing jobs that improve model-training speed and accuracy. Those models are used in brain MRI workflows to detect possible critical findings during scanning and help ensure the right images are captured early enough for radiologists to intervene sooner. By centralizing training on OCI AI infrastructure, Cerebriu shortened model development cycles, preserved headroom for future inferencing workloads, and built a cloud platform that can scale with MRI equipment partners and hospital deployments across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
